hook.text: Imagine a taxi that lifts off vertically from a rooftop and flies across the city in minutes.

buildup.text: Electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft—eVTOLs—use multiple rotors powered by batteries.

discovery.text: Over 200 companies have built eVTOL prototypes. Joby, Lilium, and Archer lead the race.

twist.text: Certification is grueling. Aviation authorities require safety standards comparable to commercial airlines.

climax.text: First commercial services are expected between 2025 and 2027 in select cities. Scale is years away.

punchline.text: Flying taxis exist. Getting permission to fly them is the hard part.
